name: @jbctechsolutions/mcp-office365
stderr:
mcp-office365 requires Node.js 24 or newer — this is Node.js 22.23.3.

The durable state store uses the built-in node:sqlite module. Node.js below
24 either lacks it entirely or exposes it only as an experimental feature
that warns on every launch. Nothing is wrong with your install.

Fix one of:
  - Upgrade to Node.js 24+ and relaunch
  - Point your MCP client at a Node.js 24+ binary (an absolute path
    avoids version-manager shims the client cannot see)
  - Pin the previous major, which supports Node.js 20+:
      npm install @jbctechsolutions/mcp-office365@4
